Drafter and reviewer on the strongest model; glosser on Sonnet. Review: pass 1, 7 minor and 16 style (a false other-recension claim at u. 31 corrected — it does have birth in the high realms, with གནས where the print's doubtful ཀས stands; stems of sgoms, klog; ལམ is mid-line; the ligature in དགོྶ is -s; ལོངས་སྤྱོད་རྫོགས་པའི་སྐུ joined and སྔར་ འདྲིས split as in 004–007); pass 2, 8 minor and 14 style, mostly glosses (thos is its own verb, not a stem of nyan; ཤ་སྟག "nothing but"; stem labels added; six broadenings); no major findings (see drafts/bardo-thodol-009/review.md). Three misprints named in the notes (དེ་ཡ → དེ་ལ, བབཁོར → བ་ཁོར, ནམ་མཁར → ནམ་མཁའ); the 14 [?] marks (not 17, as the establish log's heading says) and the guessed senses (གཞན་དག་ཀས, ཆགས་ལ་སྤྱོད་པའི, སྒྲ་ཟེར་དང, འཕྲི་བ་ལ་མེད, བརྒྱལ་བ་ཁོར་ཡུག་ཏུ, གནས་བསྒྱུར་དེ) marked uncertain.
